reconstruction_note: Original traces_generation_rejections.jsonl was lost: the worktree it lived in (/tmp/gen-traces) was removed via `git worktree remove --force` before the file was extracted. This is a reconstruction from this session's own command outputs (a tail -60 covering the first partial run, a Monitor notification and a tail -30 together covering the resumed 19-file run, and a full log for the 8-file attack-branch run which had zero rejections). Cross-checked for gaps across those three sources; coverage is believed complete, but the `reason` field below is only as complete as what each run's stdout printed (truncated to ~120-150 chars at print time), not the original full exception/response text. `kind` reflects what the generator script actually logged: all 17 of these came back as a normal run_case() return with final_response starting with "ERROR: LLM API Error 429" (run_case() catches its own HTTP exceptions internally), which the script's validation gate correctly rejected and logged under kind="malformed" rather than kind="infra" (that kind was reserved for exceptions raised past run_case(), which none of these were) - true root cause was a Groq 429 rate limit in every single case, shown in the reason text.
